summary.pl: Szybsza obsługa Onet Poczty: skróty klawiaturowe, zaznaczanie, gwiazdki, usuwanie i cofanie operacji.
summary.en-US: Faster Onet Mail handling with keyboard shortcuts, selection, starring, deletion and undo/redo.

version.approval_notes: Onet Post Companion is a Firefox-only extension for poczta.onet.pl. It runs readable, unminified first-party JavaScript only. No third-party libraries or remote code are used. The MAIN execution world is intentional because the extension intercepts the page's own fetch calls to preserve undo/redo for mail move/delete operations. The extension communicates only with poczta.onet.pl and api.poczta.onet.pl within the user's authenticated Onet Mail session. No analytics or developer servers are used.
